why: The new items pushed the model to cut earlier so that finite verbs, short disambiguating words, and connective words often landed alone on the right fragment — e.g. subjects separated from verbs and list items or contrast markers isolated — which reduces cohesion and therefore lowered H_set, with the harm concentrated on very short pieces (≤3–≤7-word bins).
lesson: A later revision should avoid wording that rewards isolating single-word disambiguators, connectives, or finite verbs into very-short right fragments (especially in ≤3–≤7 bins) because that produces many harmful subject/verb and list splits.
